news.title: Dead raccoon tests positive for rabies in Decatur neighborhood
news.summary: A dead raccoon tested positive for rabies in the Meadow Rock Drive area, DeKalb County officials confirmed Friday.

news.title: 3 sent to hospital in Atlanta shooting
news.summary: Atlanta police say that three people have been shot in southwest Atlanta on Friday night.

news.title: Six Flags Over Georgia: Goliath coaster stays closed as park reopens
news.summary: Six Flags Over Georgia in Cobb County reopened Friday for the first time following a fatal roller coaster accident.

news.title: Man accused of taking items Georgia Sports Hall of Fame
news.summary: A man was arrested this week after police said he took baseball memorabilia from the Georgia Sports Hall of Fame and caused a disturbance in a museum in downtown Macon.

news.title: Ranger, Dunwoody’s first K-9 officer, has died
news.summary: The Dunwoody Police community is mourning the loss of Ranger, the force’s first K-9 officer, who died at an Alabama training facility during the week of Oct. 12.

news.title: Arrest made in deadly shooting in Atlanta's Monroe Heights neighborhood, APD says
news.summary: A multi-agency effort led to the capture of 18-year-old Mario Johnson and another 15-year-old suspect in Urbana, Illinois.

news.title: Man sentenced to 135 years for shooting at troopers, K9 on I-85

news.title: Wanted suspect found hiding in southeast Atlanta basement, police say
news.summary: A wanted suspect facing dozens of previous charges across metro Atlanta was arrested after officers found him hiding inside the basement of a southeast Atlanta home, police announced.

news.title: Mother seeks justice after son fatally injured coming out of moving truck; says driver never stopped, witness called 911
news.summary: Nathaniel Morgan, 18, died Sept. 10 after reportedly coming out of a moving truck in Bartow County. The sheriff's office is investigating.
